crossRefs.note: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
“Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every…
Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness…
Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which…
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
“You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
“You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
“Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then…
and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses…
and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’ ”
saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

translations.web: “ ‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “ ‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.
